response.text:
Coming Out The following is a generic coming out or bring back that you can use. You can just say when you come out you will only bring out things that are useful to you in your everyday life now, otherwise you will bring them out at a later date when you are able to integrate them. When you come out you will be coming back to the room you are in now, on the day that you are doing this session on. All instructions that have been given to you that would either take you deeper into the session or keep you in the state are now finished. The only instructions or cue you will be taking with you that will either take you into this state at a later date or that you will be using in your everyday life is the one that you will consciously be choosing to use, neither of which will keep you in the state. When you come out you will be you, in your body with your adult judgement.

Then do a count up, e.g. On 1 start to feel your body again and what it's resting on and feel your weight (you can put your weight here if you like). On 2 start to feel your breathing return to normal. On 3 start to hear the room around you and know where you are. On 4 start to wiggle your fingers and toes, move your shoulders and your eyes. On 5 open your eyes whenever you like, back in the here and now, feeling normal and clear and the session is now over.

When you come out remind yourself what day or what date it is, look to your left and your right, look at something near and something far, start to move about and don't get up till you feel that you can do so without falling over. Make sure that you are orientated and alert (doing a count up will do this but not always). Take mental note of only things that have actually come up for you and if there's anything you need to do about them, then go and do something normal.

In case the recording cuts out at any time you can tell them that if it does cut out they just need to say to themselves that the recording has stopped and the session is over and then do the above by themselves, but when they open their eyes they should press either their feet or their hands into a surface as well.

NB. If you are going to sleep to a recording then it's all good and well that you are going to sleep or just lying there quietly at the end of the recording, but if you are going to come out of it then you shouldn't leave them in any sort of altered state. This also includes leaving them in a role, with lowered judgement, with lowered movements, blank or with a non specific reset word or leaving them like that for an indefinite amount of time.
